title: apmaster
description: `apmaster Ref` saves and loads all presets belonging to `Ref` and its children to or from a single text file. It can be controlled through `Ref-apmaster-rcv` with commands such as `load`, `loadfile`, `loadin`, `save`, `savefile`, and `savein`, while `Ref-apmaster-snd` reports `loaded` or `saved` with the filename.
